description: A data table (mj-table). Rows and cells are modelled, not raw HTML.

members.name: Align
members.description: Gets or sets the table alignment (align).

members.name: Border
members.description: Gets or sets the table border shorthand (border).

members.name: CellPadding
members.description: Gets or sets the cell padding (cellpadding).

members.name: CellSpacing
members.description: Gets or sets the cell spacing (cellspacing).

members.name: Color
members.description: Gets or sets the text colour (color).

members.name: FontFamily
members.description: Gets or sets the font family (font-family).

members.name: FontSize
members.description: Gets or sets the font size (font-size).

members.name: LineHeight
members.description: Gets or sets the line height (line-height).

members.name: TableLayout
members.description: Gets or sets the table layout algorithm (table-layout).

members.name: Width
members.description: Gets or sets the table width (width).
